notes.title: Reworked Pilots Tutorial
notes.content:
Completely reworked tutorial to explain all the core game mechanics.

Please do not hesitate to review the game / demo or give me feedback directly via the Steam forum or the discord : https://discord.gg/hEHSt9mpeh

Some Players have noted that Demo will not update unless you delete original. 
Waiting on Steam Support

[previewyoutube=XCkOHhLoq-c;full][/previewyoutube]

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Current Tutorial Consists Of :

Phase 1 : Basic
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
1. Move Forward
2. Move Backward
3. Move Left
4. Move Right

5. Turn Left 3x
6. Turn Right 3x

7. Jump 3x
8. Double Jump 3x

9. Grab and Release Guns 3x
10. Grab and Release Sabers 3x

Phase 2 : Intermediate : WallRun
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

1. WallRun 3x
2. Navigate Wallrun Course

Phase 3 : Intermediate : Flight Mode
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

1. Activate Flight Mode
2. Deactivate Flight Mode
3. Fly to Marker

Phase 4 : Intermediate : Flight 2
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

1. Air Dash Left 3x
2. Air Dash Right 3x
3. Air Dash Up 3x
4. Air Dash Down 3x

Phase 5 : Intermediate : Weapons
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

1. Pistols
2. Rifles
3. Rocket Grab and Release 3x
4. Reload Any Weapon 3x
5. Lock On Missiles

Phase 6 : Grapple
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

1. Grapple 3x
2. Grapple Enemy 3x
3. Change Grapple Polarity 3x

Phase 7 : Basic Melee
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

1. Pull and Release Saber
2. Activate Shield 3x
3. Strike Enemy 3x
4. Block Enemy 3x
5. Parry Enemy 
6. Kick Enemy 3x
7. Double Kick Enemy 3x
8. Jump Kick Enemy 3x
9. Wallkick Enemy 3x

Phase 8 : Intermediate Melee					
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

1. Uppercut Enemy 3x
2. Uppercut then teleport jump to Enemy
3. Goundslam Enemy

Advanced Melee				
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Coming Soon

Advanced Air Melee				
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Coming Soon

Cap Ship Defense				
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Coming Soon

Also reduced dash sensitivity
Made changes to hud for clarity
Reduced step sounds by 50%


Thanks!

notes.title: Nemesis Update - Complete Rework of Bakemono
notes.content:
Nemesis  Update — Bakemono VR   
High Mobility VR Mech Simulator - Anime Hack and Slash      
Total Rework

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36519809/6ca6032f332873d82f6634f5249d0f8ba7c1fa47.jpg[/img]
Completely rebuilt game ( 3x's ) from player feedback and performance. New
Menu, New Tutorial, New Calibration System, New Levels, New Enemy Pilots.

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/s3VyuDarPK8K4uPiNg/giphy.gif[/img]

New Gun Physics and Enemy Pilots

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36519809/f2917261be195f5e22eaeb2150beb39b1f4d5a06.jpg[/img]

Refined Controls, More Accurate Grabs

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/4YoWbQjl4eA4DiZf9Z/giphy.gif[/img]
 
Guns now fire tracers at distance for more accurate fire. 
Grabs and release accuracy improved. Reload speed increased.

UpperCuts and GroundSlams

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/yND7kAG6hFgtVv1kkQ/giphy.gif[/img]

Saber uppercuts to ground and air enemies now launches them into the air to be juggled by pistol fire or grappled to continue in air melee combos! Ground slams ( you must deactivate flight mode ) require you to dash down ( you can dash in any direction and slam the ground ) launching close enemies into the air for max damage.

Completely Reworked Tutorial

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/E2kkFbrvGDG1E9gfT2/giphy.gif?cid=790b76111215d8bb68d71635fa0773824d208468d6061e60&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

Honestly I took for granted how many advanced features there are in the game, and how anyone but the most advanced VR players would intuitively understand some of the underlying control systems and movement tricks available in the game. The majority of the feedback from the players was that the tutorial was too hard. I redesigned it many times and made over 30 illustrated cards and added them to the brand new tutorial

Large Open Worlds [ 28 Missions in Current Build - Many more in progress ]

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/sfFiVIF5buMtULPmh0/giphy.gif[/img]

Fight in large open areas with multiple avenues of approach to the objectives. Land, Sea, Air, Urban, and Zero G environments are available for hardcore pilots to traverse and master. Levels were rebuilt to accommodate the wall runs which will later be added to the combo and scoring system itself similar to rails in THPS.

New models, new mechs, new air units, new capital ships
  
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/X5mYWCIhU9ZtquL3N2/giphy.gif[/img]
  
Enemy Pilots

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/VBkPTBewX1CFWkvFlw/giphy.gif?cid=790b76116e6bc1daa1b8505888405589e9da427e481bd8fe&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

New Enemy Pilot Animation Cards, AI Routines, and Voice Overs. Scattered about the missions in the Arcade Mode [ 19 Missions ] and the Prologue [ Currently 9 Missions ] are enemy contractors who are much more advanced and fearsome than the standard Sky Dominion AI Mechanical Yeomanry

High Mobility in VR : Grapple, Wallrun, and Flight Mode

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/Xz5KvXrItIUFOeUsKh/giphy.gif?cid=790b76116bf7df444e1731a176ebbe6689f8ca8ba88d2e0b&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

Toggle Flight Mode at Will to evade fire, avoid missile circus attacks, copters, and enemy ships ( air and zero g )

Grapple walls, structures, ships for easy saber kills. Grapple enemy units on the ground and in the air to slash them or kick them into walls and floors.

Hardcore Anime - Hand Drawn 2D

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/93Be2jzzPhvnMuArg1/giphy.gif?cid=790b761151fcff98212cd93e37fe3ff18d5a53564acdbbb3&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

All the characters and cutscenes are designed and animated in the traditional anime style

Melee and Combat

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/zaYfzSyi12B2Etq74q/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611fa5281119fb228a52513151c08660b0f4d30e92e&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

Parry Sabers, Laser Weapons, Ground and Air Mechs in Combat

[list]  [*]Slice Capital Ships
  [/*]  [*]Block Missiles, Standard Ammunition, Laser Weapons, and Railcannon blasts with the Laser shield
  [/*]  [*]Mechs and ships are all sliceable
  [/*][/list]

2021 Roadmap

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36519809/b90efc0588eae9d45ddc40e084b1c22bb6a1e64e.jpg[/img]

A new menu, A new calibration system and a bunch of new UI and UX improvements
  
LIV Integration  

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/OsTL6allWSWDfVVerR/giphy.gif[/img]

I will also be adding a  in game 3rd person camera in the game at a later date. Working closely with LIV to make the avatar system as robust as possible.

Features Temporarily Removed
[list]  [*]Some VOs Don't Match Fixing Shortly
  [/*]  [*]When Calibrating in Menu [ Not In Game ] If you recalibrate requiring TPose, you must exit with left hand, as right hand input is captured for calibration
      [/*]  [*]Some Sounds are too loud.[/*]    [*]Some Arcade Mode Level Kill Limits Incorrectly Set  - Will be updating immediately
  [/*]  [*]Mission Videos Inbound
      [/*]  [*]In level Mission Objectives Not on Compass - Fixing Immediately
[/*][/list]
Join our communities to directly talk to us:
▬▬▬ [url=https://discord.gg/hEHSt9mpeh][u]DISCORD[/u][/url] ▬▬▬
